_doc: Pre-registered exclusion rules and hand exclusions for the frozen hard split. Fill BEFORE running an arm comparison; never after seeing one arm's outcome. Every entry needs a reason. E0 reports results with and without these. task_exclusions entries need a rule id from `rules`. instruction_deviations records every task whose as-run instruction differs from the frozen benchmark wording; such a task is never silently re-labelled as a benchmark task.

rules.description: Start URL returns 5xx / DNS failure / connection reset in every paired arm on the same day
Site serves a region block page from the evaluation region in every paired arm
Captcha challenge not cleared by solver in every paired arm

The arms of a task were not all run on the study's pinned host model (protocol.model differs across the task's records). The same-model pin of the protocol is violated, so the task leaves every primary table; it is reported in the n=24 sensitivity line.
rules.adjudication: deterministic: protocol.model not identical across the task's arm records; never outcome-based

task_exclusions.reason: spothero.com: 4 of 8 arms (no_deadend, fresh_vision, flat, no_ladder) ran on minimax/minimax-m3 after an operator config change; the other 4 on z-ai/glm-5.3-flash. Same-model pin violated. Not outcome-based: all 8 arms failed the task, so no numerator changes; denominators become 23.

legacy_66_task_reconciliation.note: List here the task_ids that made up the paper's 66-task run (or the rule that removed 8 tasks from the 74-task hard split) once known.

instruction_deviations.upstream_instruction: View the cheapest apartment available for students at the University of Leeds with bills that include WIFI and cleaning services.
instruction_deviations.as_run_instruction: View the cheapest apartment available for students at the University of Texas Austin under 2500 dollars
instruction_deviations.arms_affected: all 8 (identical text in every arm; paired comparisons unaffected)

discarded_variant.instruction: View the cheapest apartment available for students at the University of Texas Austin with bills that include WIFI and cleaning services.

instruction_deviations.reason: REASON PENDING FROM AUTHOR — the instruction was rewritten by the authors before the arms ran; the Online-Mind2Web wording was never run under this experiment.
instruction_deviations.handling: kept in the primary analysis and disclosed; the frozen benchmark file is unchanged (sha256 in manifest.json)
